# Pinned flake list for sign.yml (scripts/ci/flake_retry.py). One pytest test id per line, then `#` and the
# issue that tracks the real fix. A line without an issue link is rejected. A failure in a listed test is
# re-run once by the Sign release manifest run; any other failure fails it. Remove a line when its issue closes.
# An id matches itself and its parametrized variants (`id[...]`).
